featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 全部页面的卡片按主次建立视觉层级，主要卡片增加原生边缘光轨动画；系统开启“减少动态效果”或窗口不可见时自动静止。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Cards on every page now have a clear visual hierarchy, and primary cards gain a native animated edge glow that stays still when Reduce Motion is on or the window is not visible.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 分布图把 Token 约数与精确数量分两行显示，便于同时读取概览与准确值。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Distribution charts show the approximate token count and the exact amount on separate lines for easier reading.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 升级 GPUI 组件库到 0.8.1 及配套图形框架，保持各平台原生渲染兼容。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Upgrade the GPUI component library to 0.8.1 and its graphics framework to keep native rendering compatible across platforms.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Windows 打开皮肤目录时部分系统文件管理器扩展因缺少 COM 单线程环境而失败的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix opening skin folders on Windows when system file-manager extensions require a COM single-threaded apartment.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Windows 后台额度查询可能弹出控制台窗口的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Prevent background quota queries from opening console windows on Windows.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 改善未安装 sqlite3 命令时 Windows 上 Cursor 本地账户状态的读取兼容性。
bugFixes.en-US: Improve compatibility when reading local Cursor account state on Windows without the sqlite3 command.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Windows 睡眠恢复后局域网设备广播未及时重建的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Rebuild local network device advertising promptly after Windows resumes from sleep.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Windows SDK 编译器路径包含多个匹配结果时的构建失败。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix builds when Windows SDK compiler lookup returns multiple matching paths.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 卸载时正确清理当前安装拥有的登录启动命令，并保留其它启动配置。
bugFixes.en-US: Remove login startup commands owned by the current installation during uninstall while preserving other startup settings.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复空白或未扫描的 Agent 隐藏其它工具今日总 Token 的问题，桌宠与展示终端保留有效数字及数据质量标记。
bugFixes.en-US: Keep valid daily token totals and quality indicators on desktop pets and display clients when another Agent is empty or unscanned.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 支持Windows、macOS和Linux展示终端使用真实平台身份配对与连接。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Support pairing and connecting Windows, macOS, and Linux display clients with their actual platform identity.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 设备卡片按PC系统显示笔记本图示，屏幕内包含对应经典壁纸和系统徽标。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Show platform-specific laptop artwork with classic wallpapers and system logos on PC device cards.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 兼容Grok与Cursor联名套餐的共享周额度及新版Cursor加密登录态，保留旧额度接口回退。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Support the shared weekly allowance in Grok and Cursor bundles and encrypted Cursor sign-in data, with fallback for older quota endpoints.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 系统睡眠或已配对设备持续离线时重建mDNS广播，改善长时间运行后无法发现的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Rebuild mDNS advertising after system sleep or prolonged offline periods to improve discovery during long-running sessions.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 按本次批准以 v0.9.3 维护重发；将后台服务与宿主驱动拆为独立工作区，会话日志解析和数据源身份统一归入核心层，保持现有功能与数据格式。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Publish the approved v0.9.3 maintenance release; separate background services and host drivers into workspace crates, and centralize session-log parsing and source identities in core while preserving existing behavior and data formats.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复应用换肤页在窄窗口中裁切卡片名称、作者、徽标和应用按钮的问题，完整卡片可正常纵向滚动。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix App Skins cards losing names, authors, badges, and Apply buttons in narrow windows; complete cards now scroll vertically.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复英文导入和创建主题按钮文字被压缩的问题，工具栏按完整文字宽度自动换行。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix clipped English labels on Import and Create theme buttons; toolbar actions now wrap with their full text.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 按明确选择以 v0.9.1 重新构建 Windows、macOS 与 Linux 双架构安装包；本次为维护重发，产品功能与 v0.9.0 一致。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Rebuild the Windows, macOS and both Linux architecture packages as v0.9.1 as explicitly requested; this maintenance reissue preserves the product behavior of v0.9.0.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 设备在线状态使用绿色胶囊；iPhone 卡片增加 Watch 小图和独立在线状态，并优化设备图片资源。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add green device status badges, a Watch illustration with independent status inside iPhone cards, and optimized device artwork.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 终端完整快照与小组件摘要同步桌面 Agent 启用名单，提供商额度随设置筛选。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Sync enabled Agents to terminal snapshots and widget summaries, and filter provider quotas using desktop settings.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增真实界面展示、分步使用教程与架构说明，并对齐项目文档和源码注释。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add real interface screenshots, step-by-step usage instructions, and architecture documentation, and align project docs and source comments.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Cursor 今日空响应处理，统一日期筛选，并按已保存的扫描间隔自动更新账户数据。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix Cursor empty-day responses, unify date filters, and refresh account data using the saved scan interval.

bugFixes.zh-CN: Cursor账户用量表格文字统一左对齐，并清理概览顶部重复统计与说明。
bugFixes.en-US: Left-align the Cursor account usage tables and remove duplicate statistics and explanatory text above the overview.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增独立 Cursor 账户用量看板，支持今日、昨日、本周、上周、本月和上月的云端 Token 分项及日期、模型汇总。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add a separate Cursor account usage dashboard with cloud token breakdowns and daily and model summaries for today, yesterday, this week, last week, this month, and last month.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 明确区分缺失与零值并显示字段覆盖条数；账户用量独立于本机统计，支持取消读取和主动重新读取。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Distinguish missing fields from zero and show field coverage counts; keep account usage separate from local statistics and support cancellation and explicit refresh.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Cursor 独立访问令牌缺少用户标识前缀导致额度请求返回 401 的问题，兼容已有会话格式。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix Cursor quota requests returning 401 when a standalone access token lacks its user-ID session prefix, while preserving existing session formats.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 发布工具在公证失败时保留脱敏后的具体步骤、退出码与诊断，便于定位错误。
bugFixes.en-US: Preserve the failing notarization operation, exit code and redacted diagnostics in release-tool errors.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 仅对票据服务的临时错误有限重试，签名、公证回执或附票验证失败仍阻断发布。
bugFixes.en-US: Retry transient ticket-service errors a bounded number of times while continuing to block publication on failed signature, receipt or stapling checks.

bugFixes.zh-CN: Windows 状态栏命令回归测试先解码已有 PowerShell 命令，再检查原有行为。
bugFixes.en-US: Decode the existing PowerShell command in Windows status-line regression tests before checking its behavior.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 候选目录接续登记测试明确区分后台失败与有界等待，保留未提前索引和真实数据库断言。
bugFixes.en-US: Distinguish background failure from bounded waiting in candidate-registration tests while retaining real database and no-early-indexing assertions.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修正更新日志弹窗测试对空日志节点的依赖，兼容正式候选嵌入的真实日志。
bugFixes.en-US: Make release-notes dialog tests work with both empty development logs and real notes embedded in release builds.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修正 Windows 皮肤监视任务回归测试的模块引用，使原生 CI 能编译并执行已有断言。
bugFixes.en-US: Correct module references in Windows skin watcher regression tests so native CI can compile and execute the existing assertions.
